turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

01:20 PM

I understand you want to know how quickly you need to act. You can cancel an order if it has not been collected yet. If it has already left, it cannot be canceled and you would need to return it after delivery using the returns form: https://www.nordicoutdoor.co.uk/returns . There is no specific published time window in hours or days, so the key is to request cancellation immediately after placing the order.
